lanes.summary: FAIL: `scripts/binary_snapshot.sh` weakens/breaks the required `--twice` determinism check by comparing `$work/a` to itself (`cmp -s "$work/a" "$work/a"`) instead of comparing `$work/a` to `$work/b` at line 168 (introduced in commit 8eb1bf11d16ecb4afb31cd79eafc5b1a52efdd88).

findings.claim: The `--twice` determinism check in `scripts/binary_snapshot.sh` compares `$work/a` against itself (`if cmp -s "$work/a" "$work/a"; then`) instead of comparing `$work/a` against `$work/b`. As a result, `bash scripts/binary_snapshot.sh --twice` is a tautology that always succeeds and prints `DETERMINISTIC` even if the two generated snapshots (`$work/a` and `$work/b`) differ, rendering the `NON-DETERMINISTIC` failure path on lines 172-173 unreachable and violating the ticket's `--twice` determinism requirement.
findings.fix: Change line 168 from `if cmp -s "$work/a" "$work/a"; then` to `if cmp -s "$work/a" "$work/b"; then`.
